emails.job: Get the new account administrator to connect the first drive with an accurate expectation of when search will begin working.
emails.single_idea: Connecting the first drive starts background indexing, and the reader can begin searching as soon as the first folder finishes indexing rather than waiting for the whole drive.
emails.mechanism: After the reader connects a drive, Portway indexes it in the background. Search becomes available when the first folder completes indexing, while indexing can continue beyond that point.
emails.belief_shift: Before: connecting a drive may leave the reader unsure when it becomes useful for search. After: the reader knows that connection starts background indexing and that search works once the first folder finishes.
must_not_say: Do not claim search is available immediately when the drive is connected.
Do not claim the entire drive must finish indexing before search works.
Do not promise a setup duration, indexing speed or amount of effort.
Do not name or imply support for any particular drive provider or integration.
Do not make security, compliance, reliability, customer adoption or performance claims.
Do not introduce pricing, plans, guarantees, support or migration claims.
Do not imply every file is searchable when only the first folder has finished indexing.
emails.objection: When will I be able to search after I connect the drive?
emails.next_step_decision: Whether to start indexing the first drive now so its files can begin becoming searchable.
emails.next_step_value: The action lets the administrator connect a drive, which starts Portway indexing it in the background; search becomes available after the first folder finishes indexing.
emails.next_step_limit: Connecting the drive does not mean the entire drive is indexed immediately; the supplied material gives no indexing-time estimate, and search availability begins specifically after the first folder finishes.
emails.subject_strategy: Set a practical onboarding expectation by pairing the next action with the search-availability milestone; avoid urgency, vague benefit language and any promise of instant or fully completed indexing.

brief.voice_notes: Use the default plain, direct voice: “Hi there,” short paragraphs, first-person team voice and “- the team.” Keep the email focused on the action and indexing sequence.

emails.role: Prompt the first drive connection and clarify search timing
emails.subject: Connect your drive, then search
emails.preview_text: Indexing runs in the background, and search starts after the first folder is ready.
emails.body:
Your first drive connection puts Portway to work.

Portway is a searchable workspace for files in a connected shared drive. Once you connect a drive, Portway begins indexing it in the background.

Search becomes available as soon as the first folder finishes indexing. You can begin searching at that point while Portway continues indexing beyond that folder.

The connection starts the process; it does not make the entire drive searchable immediately. There is no need to wait for the whole drive to finish before using search.

Start the connection when you are ready for the first folder to begin indexing.
